title: ML Pipeline Model Specification
description: Schema for entries in models.json and custom_models.json

name.description: Unique identifier used in code and results (e.g. 'CatBoostRegressor')

display_name.description: Human-readable label shown in the UI

task.description: Which ML tasks this model supports

default_params.description: Default keyword arguments passed to the constructor

optuna_space.description: Hyperparameter search space for Optuna. Keys are constructor argument names.

log.description: Use log scale (float only). Useful for learning_rate, alpha, C.

finetune_window.description: Fraction (0-1) of the original search range to use for fine-tuning around the best found parameters

requires_scaling.description: Whether this model requires feature scaling (StandardScaler applied if true)

supports_warmstart.description: Whether the model supports warm-starting from a pre-trained checkpoint

tags.description: Optional tags for filtering/grouping in the UI (e.g. 'linear', 'boosting', 'fast')
